title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

repo_url.title: Repo URL
repo_url.description: Which repository does this workflow record govern?

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who owns the map and runs the cadence comparison, as role:handle?

scaffolding_tool.title: Scaffolding tool
scaffolding_tool.description: Which tool generates boilerplate and scaffolding, or ai-off?

tests_tool.title: Tests tool
tests_tool.description: Which tool generates unit tests (templates/gen-tests.sh uses Claude Code), or ai-off?

primary_tool.title: Primary tool
primary_tool.description: Which tool is used most, so its context file and retention terms are listed first?

context_file_path.title: Context file path
context_file_path.description: Where is the primary tool's context file (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md)?

context_reviewed_on.title: Context file reviewed on
context_reviewed_on.description: When were its commands and conventions last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD?

exclusion_file.title: Exclusion file
exclusion_file.description: Which ignore file keeps secrets and data out of the tools' context (.cursorignore, .claudeignore, .gitignore)?

retention_source_url.title: Retention source URL
retention_source_url.description: Where are the primary tool's data-usage and retention terms published?

ai_label.title: AI-assisted label
ai_label.description: What PR label or field marks AI-assisted diffs (e.g. ai-assisted)?

context_file_url.title: Context file URL
context_file_url.description: What URL points at the committed primary context file?

review_cadence.title: Review cadence
review_cadence.description: How often are AI-assisted and other PRs compared — monthly or quarterly?
